WITH per_event_avg AS (
  SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.event_name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM per_event_avg
),
above_avg_events AS (
  SELECT pea.event_name, pea.avg_amount
  FROM per_event_avg pea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE pea.avg_amount > oa.overall_avg
),
above_avg_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as above_avg_avg_amount
  FROM above_avg_events
)
SELECT 
  aae.event_name,
  aae.avg_amount,
  aae.avg_amount - oa.overall_avg,
  aae.avg_amount / aaa.above_avg_avg_amount
FROM above_avg_events aae
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN above_avg_avg aaa
